name: Fair-value-gap fill, LuxAlgo gap (threshold + wick fill)
why: Three 5-minute bars whose first high is below the third low left a one-sided move with no two-way business inside it; the first return into the gap fills the resting orders of the side that missed the move, and a close back above the gap top shows they were enough (mirror for shorts). Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_luxalgo_smc.md). LuxAlgo definitions: 2026-10-18_luxalgo_faithful.md.
